_comment: Example ninfer-supervisor configuration. Copy to supervisor.json and edit.
The real one is gitignored because its paths are machine-specific.
engine.args is what the supervisor launches. When a models catalog is
present it is rewritten from the selected entry on every switch, so treat
it as derived rather than as the place to edit flags.
Never put the key in args. Set api_key_file and the supervisor passes
--api-key-file, which keeps the secret off a command line that every
process running as this user can read.
_models_comment: Optional. Omit the whole array and the supervisor behaves exactly as it did
before it existed: engine.args is the only configuration.
Each entry carries its OWN flags, because switching models is not a path
swap. The 27B wants int8 KV and MTP speculation; Flash-Next wants fp8 KV,
a GDN state dtype, a different capacity, and rejects --host-state-slots
above its 64 state-slot ceiling. An entry that inherits another model's
tuning fails in target planning seconds after launch.
GET /api/models validates each artifact as the request is served: exists,
regular file, readable, and carries the NInfer v2 magic. POST /api/model
with {"id": "..."} switches, waits for the new model to actually serve,
and restores the previous one if it does not.
